entries.title: Fixed-Payout Desktop Tape Dispenser
entries.description: One newly authored static florist wrapping-station tape-dispenser prop: one integral grounded base with two U-notched side supports and a front cutter neck; one lower-seated octagonal axle; one closed annular tape mass genuinely continuous with a flat oblique free tail; and one complete four-tooth linear cutter plate with a flat landing ledge. The free tail terminates on that elevated ledge ahead of the roll rather than as a floor sweep or separately retained cable end. All material is opaque untextured constant PBR; native metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal-bound-centred ground origin. Counted once, not a scene or a family variant. The thick annular mass is only a fixed tape-roll appearance, NOT separate realistic windings, an unwinding simulation, adhesive or working feed. Installed bore clearance subtracts the real axle; side supports partially occlude the core mouths and are evaluated through separate complete notch egress volumes, never called an unobstructed full bore through the assembled stand. Mathematical contacts and empty domains do not certify cutting sharpness, tape adhesion, movement, dispensing, assembly route, stability, material strength, safe handling, fabrication or commercial operation. No old backdrop, reel, cradle, stapler or other asset geometry is imported.
